entities.summary: Manthaturath was a monarchs & rulers in Luang Prabang (1772, Luang Prabang – 1837-03-07), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with political systems and governance and empire and colonial dynamics. Established dynastic legacies and territorial boundaries.
